AvailsForDeviceType.description: Avails breakdown for a specific device type.

impressionOpportunities.description: The number of impression opportunities per day per device.

advertisingDealId.description: Reference to the associated advertising deal.

availsByDeviceType.description: A list of avails broken down by device type.

availsTotal.description: The total number of impression opportunities.

averageCpm.description: Historical cost per thousand impressions over the period of time specified.

bidRequests.description: The volume of bids with this deal ID that are eligible for the Amazon DSP.

bidResponses.description: The number of bid responses sent back to SSP or publisher for the applicable deal ID.

clickthroughCount.description: The number of times an ad is clicked.

completionCount.description: The number of times a video or audio ad is completed.

conversionCount.description: The number of times an impression resulted in an action.

dealPerformanceId.description: A unique identifier for the performance record.

measurableImpressions.description: The number of impressions that were measurable.

metricsLastUpdated.description: Last time the metrics were updated.

performanceEndDate.description: End date for performance metrics period.

performanceStartDate.description: Start date for performance metrics period.

recognizedBids.description: The number of bid requests which include a recognized deal ID. This is divided by total bid requests for the deal to get recognition rate.

totalImpressions.description: The number of times an advertisement was displayed.

totalSpend.description: The total amount spent on the deal over the period of time specified.

viewableImpressions.description: The number of impressions that were viewable.
